subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Charity is not just giving.”?
options: It also shows that someone has thought about the person using it.
It is giving in a way that protects the person receiving it.
It is giving useful information before the person feels embarrassed to ask.
Things that look alike still need a way to be told apart.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「It also shows that someone has thought about the person using it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Charity is not just giving. It is giving in a way that protects the person receiving it.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「It is giving useful information before the person feels embarrassed to ask.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Things that look alike still need a way to be told apart.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Charity is not just giving. It is giving in a way that protects the person receiving it.」，答案為「It is giving in a way that protects the person receiving it.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「It is giving in a way that protects the person receiving it.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
